exposure: Maternal exposure to Mozart compositions via headphones abdominally for 1 hour daily during pregnancy
outcome: Newborn umbilical cord serum Brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) levels
cohort: The study included pregnant women with low-risk pregnancies who were 32 weeks of gestational age at the start of the study.
finding: Newborns exposed to Mozart compositions during pregnancy had significantly higher umbilical cord serum BDNF levels (12221.33 pg/ml) compared to the non-exposed control group (8577.60 pg/ml).
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed related to mode of delivery (p > 0.05).
